description: Header file defining thread-safe low-level raw logging routines for the Abseil library, including macros for logging and checking conditions, and internal functions for raw log handling.

classes.name: LogFilterAndPrefixHook
classes.description: Function pointer type for customizing raw log message filtering and prefixing.

classes.name: AbortHook
classes.description: Function pointer type for aborting the process on fatal logs.

classes.name: InternalLogFunction
classes.description: Function pointer type for internal logging dispatch.

methods.name: RawLog
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at a given severity level without memory allocation or locking.

methods.name: AsyncSignalSafeWriteToStderr
methods.description: Writes a buffer directly to stderr in a signal-safe manner.

methods.name: Basename
methods.description: Extracts the base filename from a full file path at compile time.

methods.name: RawLoggingFullySupported
methods.description: Checks if raw logging is fully supported on the current platform.

methods.name: RegisterLogFilterAndPrefixHook
methods.description: Registers a hook for customizing log filtering and prefixing.

methods.name: RegisterAbortHook
methods.description: Registers a hook to abort the process on fatal logs.

methods.name: RegisterInternalLogFunction
methods.description: Registers a custom internal log dispatch function.
